title: The whole BEO kitchen plan reaches the till

created.label: ZZ TEST SCRUM-906 kids band printer
ZZ TEST SCRUM-906 adult band printer

1 the whole plan on the till (party WITH.facts: GET /api/parties/:id (till origin) 200, planStatus ready, kitchenPlan: the 8 set-menu lines named with their group (Pizza: Margherita, Hot dish: Chicken schnitzel, French fries, Waffles or pancakes: Waffles, Fried rice: Veggie, Veggie sticks, Fruit skewers [not on till], Drinks pitcher: Juice [not on till]); Calamari x2 entered 120 (CF-14); Hummus x1 no price (CF-13); ZZ TEST mango sticky rice x2 entered 90 [not on till]; ZZ TEST fruit plate x1 [not on till]; bar: Fresh cold pressed orange juice x4 SET (CF-63-1), Mineral water x2 EXTRA (CF-65-6), ZZ TEST lemonade pitcher x2 [not on till]; bar service 19:15; cake our x1 20:30 "ZZ TEST unicorn". Desk and phone pages show every line, the hand-typed ones marked "not on the till menu", the cake row "Our cake x1 · 20:30 / ZZ TEST unicorn". The page writes a chosen dish "Pizza · Margherita" (the slip writes "Pizza: Margherita"). The entered prices were written through the BEO save route (PUT /api/events/:id/beo): the editor has no price box on kitchen or bar lines.

2 a staff choice after the parent's.facts: Parent chose Fried rice: Veggie through the link (submit 200). Staff renamed the resolved line in the BEO editor and saved (PUT 200): the till api answered "Fried rice: Chicken" 1.3 s later. Open pages left alone: both tills had LOCKED after 2 minutes idle (the till's inactivity lock) and showed nothing; after unlock the desk showed Chicken at once. Second change Chicken -> Shrimp with the tills kept awake (a Shift key every 25 s, no click, no focus): desk showed Shrimp 34 s after the save, phone 52 s. The parent's link page (reloaded) lists "Fried rice: Shrimp"; GET public link selections say the same. Later Shrimp -> Chicken again for point 4.

3 a party with NO package.facts: GET /api/parties/:id 200, planStatus no_package, kitchenPlan: ZZ TEST nuggets plate x3 [not on till], French fries x1 (CF-11), bar Mineral water x2, cake own 17:00 "ZZ TEST family cake". Desk page: no Package row, cake row "Customer brings their own · 17:00", bar plan; the buttons are Edit party, Add tickets, Add F&B to party, Fully paid (no Settle party). POST /api/parties/:id/settle/preview 409 PARTY_NO_PACKAGE "This party has no package in the OTO App, so it cannot be settled here".

4 slips on the ZZ TEST till.facts: Park named no party slips station at start; the ZZ TEST till named 20:29:30-20:42:15 Bangkok. One full job tick with it named printed nothing. "Print party slips now" (POST /api/parties/:id/slips/print 200): 1 kitchen + 1 bar job, printed. Kitchen slip: every kitchen line incl. Fruit skewers, Drinks pitcher: Juice, ZZ TEST mango sticky rice and ZZ TEST fruit plate marked "not on the till menu", and "1x Our Cake / Cake time 20:30 · ZZ TEST unicorn". Bar slip: 4x Fresh cold pressed orange juice, 2x Mineral water, 2x ZZ TEST lemonade pitcher (not on the till menu). Change A (fruit plate 1 -> 2, kitchen only): one kitchen UPDATED slip 54 s after the save (13:31:45 -> 13:32:39 UTC), no VOID (by the SCRUM-861 rule a VOID lists only what a station lost), nothing at the bar, nothing later. Change B (Fried rice Shrimp -> Chicken and lemonade 2 -> 1, one save): kitchen VOID "1x Fried rice: Shrimp" + UPDATED, bar VOID "1x ZZ TEST lemonade pitcher" + UPDATED, drawn by the simulated printers 24 s after the save (13:39:15 -> 13:39:39-40 UTC), nothing on two later ticks. Print record at the till: 7 jobs, all printed. Audit: party.slips_print 1 (reprint, our till), party.slips_change 2 (run 1 kitchen updated; run 2 kitchen void+updated, bar void+updated).

5 settlement and refund.facts: Settle preview and sale Z90601-000001: Birthday package 16,900; Calamari 2 x 120 = 240 (entered price); Hummus 1 x 275 = 275 (till price, no entered price); ZZ TEST mango sticky rice 2 x 90 = 180 (typed, entered price); Mineral water 2 x 60 = 120 (bar EXTRA, till price); ZZ TEST fruit plate and ZZ TEST lemonade pitcher (typed, no price) not charged; cake not charged; set-menu lines not charged. Total 17,715 (VAT incl. 1,158.93; extras taxed fnb). First Confirm refused 409 STOCK_SHORT "Regular Socks is out of stock. Nothing was saved." (the form defaults socks given to the kids; staging has 0 socks) - socks set to 0, then settled; cash 17,715, finalised. Manager refund whole from History (Service recovery): 200, refunded 17,715, sale refunded, settlement state refunded; the party page reads as before settlement (Settle party offered, bill 0).

6 the release.verdict: PASS (behaviour) / FAIL (counts on the Health page)
6 the release.facts: GET /api/ops/health job:parties.slips: status ok, last outcome ok, every 60 s - but NO counts (notCaughtUp, changesRebased): the register gives status only, and the Console Health page draws the same; the counts are kept only in the run record, which no api returns for an ok run (not read: no database access). Through the api: audit party.slips_schedule_start 2 rows at 20:13:34-35 (both parks, startedAt 13:13:33Z = the first tick after the api went live 13:11:38Z); party.slips_rebase 1 row 20:13:36 at Central Floresta (a party printed before the release; nothing printed for it); no kitchen or bar job at either park from 13:11Z until this run's own press (20:30); party 2 (no package, 11:00) never printed by the schedule while the ZZ TEST till was named (no slip records, no print audit).

7 the BEO PDF.facts: GET /api/events/:id/beo/pdf 200 application/pdf, 2 pages: "2x Calamari EXTRA 120฿ each", "2x ZZ TEST mango sticky rice EXTRA 90฿ each"; Hummus, fruit plate, Mineral water, lemonade show EXTRA with no price; "Expected total (from the till): ฿17,715"; no staff name in its text.

8 a very large quantity.facts: Party 2 (no package): ZZ TEST nuggets plate saved as 250000 (PUT 200): the till api and page show the whole plan with "x250000"; party 3 (with package): a typed line of 250000 added - planStatus ready, plan present, every line shown, settle preview 200 (total 16,900, the unpriced typed line not charged).

9 nothing else moved.facts: Party 3, package only: the till shows the package, the eight set-menu groups with no counts and the Included box, as SCRUM-909's 05a showed before this lane; the only difference is "Fruit skewers · not on the till menu" (the new mark for an uncoded line). Settle preview: package 16,900 only. SCRUM-916 on party 1 while its settlement was open: desk bill "Settlement open ฿17715 to take / Outstanding ฿17715", buttons Resume settlement ฿17715, Cancel settlement, Take balance ฿17715, no Fully paid; phone "DUE ฿17715", button "Settlement open · ฿17715" disabled, no Fully paid.

deploys.file: deploys.json (before: all four live at f17359759; after: api, pos-web and pos at 963605c97)
deploys.note: Points 1 to 4 and point 6 (13:16-13:42 UTC) ran with all four services at f17359759. During point 5 another deploy went live: oto-pos-staging 13:41:05Z, oto-pos-web-staging 13:43:22Z, oto-api-staging 13:44:52Z, all at 963605c97, which contains f17359759 and adds POS money/party-bill/history changes (PartyDetail, MobilePartyDetail, usePartyPlanRead, partySettlementBill, PartySettleModal) and, in the api, only a sale supervision gate (services/sale.ts). The settlement (13:46), refund (13:48), points 8 and 9 (13:49-13:50) therefore ran on 963605c97 tills and api; whether each open page had loaded the new bundle was not checked. The OTO App stayed at f17359759 throughout.

findings: D1 (prices, BEO vs bill): the BEO editor has no price box on kitchen or bar lines (beo-event-editor.tsx, SCRUM-822 removed it), so an "entered price" can only come from the till-menu pick, AI fill or the api; staff cannot type 120 or see it on the editor. The editor shows no price for any line, the PDF shows "120฿ each" only where a price was entered, and EXTRA lines with no entered price (Hummus, Mineral water) are charged at the till price (275, 2 x 60) with no figure anywhere on the BEO but its expected total.
